_comment: 松井社長の 立ち絵（対話ゲーム・願い #177）。正典は 設定シート sheet.webp（docs/skills/codex_image_generation.md §6.5）。looks は content/characters/matsui.json から 逐語で 写す。
style: Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, warm daylight, contemporary Japan, kid-safe e-learning illustration.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border.
negative: Never: realistic photo rendering, harsh gradients, six fingers, extra limbs, readable letters, dark horror tone, angry or crying faces, costume changes.

scenes.title: ふつう（聞いて いる）
scenes.output: Output: one portrait cut-out illustration, 1024x1536, the character ALONE on a fully transparent background (alpha channel, nothing behind him: no floor, no wall, no ground shadow, no props). Centered horizontally, cropped by the bottom edge at mid-thigh, with a small margin on the left, right and top.
scenes.scene:
Character: 代表取締役社長 — Japanese-style anime character, man in his forties, ordinary build with normal shoulders and a normal waist — do NOT broaden the body, do NOT make him stout. Calm confident posture. Black hair with volume on top and a soft fringe falling across the forehead. Fair skin, oval face that is just a touch soft: gently rounded cheeks and a slightly soft jawline, only a hint fuller than slim — not chubby, no double chin. Narrow gentle eyes with single-fold lids, straight sparse eyebrows, a small rounded nose, gentle friendly closed-lip smile. Outfit: navy single-breasted blazer (#1F2A44) worn open over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, dark navy trousers, brown leather shoes. No tie, no glasses.
Pose: standing straight, facing the viewer, both arms relaxed at his sides, calm attentive expression with a gentle closed-lip smile, listening to the person in front of him.
